correctness.rationale: The incidence graph depends only on prime supports. Repeated left supports from p,p^2 when n not squarefree, or repeated right supports when S has a collision, give fixed-point-free transpositions of perfect matchings and even multiplicity. Squarefree n has 2^r distinct divisor supports; distinct right supports of that cardinality exhaust the Boolean lattice, and matching right support T to left complement P\T is forced by decreasing-size induction. In an AP of 2^r terms, exactly half must be multiples of each p|n; if p|b this is impossible, and if p>=3, ceil(2^r/p)<2^(r-1) for r>=3. In r=2 the largest prime must be 3 so n=6, and parity and mod-3 residues yield the listed congruences. Includes n=1, primes, b divisible by p, and zero matchings. Independently counted 1890 bounded gcd-DP instances and compared actual parity and uniqueness.

final_claim: For every n>=1 and every distinct positive target set S of size tau(n), the number of coprime divisor-to-target bijections is 1 exactly when n is squarefree and S realizes every n-prime support pattern once; otherwise it is even. For positive AP targets a+bt the unique cases are n=1, prime n=p with exactly one of a,a+b divisible by p, and n=6 with 3|a and gcd(b,6)=1.
